thoughts: The retention rate of 0.3% is an emergency-level failure, indicating the 'hook' (first 1-2 seconds) is non-existent. The current video of a model simply walking in a tunnel is too generic and lacks the 'urban grit' promised in the subhead. While contrast is technically high (white on black), the visual aesthetic is too clean/sterile, which creates a cognitive dissonance with the 'Reclaimed/Street' copy. The 0% CTR suggests the CTA doesn't feel urgent or exclusive enough.
contrast_audit: Pass - The white sans-serif text on a pure black background achieves a 21:1 contrast ratio, exceeding WCAG AAA standards. However, the video's lighting could wash this out if the subject moves behind the text.
